about: Screens new to the speed gate (e2e/screen-times.mjs --learning): reported, not judged, from the date given, until their runs reach e2e/screen-history.json and ceilingsFrom derives their ceilings; then each comes off this list. An entry past LEARNING_DAYS, one whose screen has a ceiling, or one no flow reached in a whole run, fails the run.
